subject.workingTree: uncommitted H1-H4 diff in app/api/admin/posts/[id]/route.ts, app/api/admin/posts/route.ts, app/api/blog/route.ts, app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx, lib/db.ts, middleware.ts (sha256 of `git diff -- app lib middleware.ts` prefix 2df991b4f324cd97, unchanged from start to end of this run)

method: Independent re-run of SPEC-02 'Local verification' items 1-7 against the H-series working tree: fresh PG16 cluster, fresh build, fresh `next start -p 3100`, own smoke/revalidation scripts, own local mock webhook. Implementer claims were not reused.

checks.name: 2. Local PG16 with blog tables (schema+data) and other tables schema-only
checks.expected: cluster up on :54329, DB growmax, blog_posts/blog_redirects loaded, PII tables empty
checks.actual: initdb + pg_ctl start OK; pg_restore --schema-only schema.dump (1 ignored error: schema public already exists); pg_restore --data-only blog-tables.dump. Counts: blog_posts=171 (171 published), blog_redirects=95, demo_requests=0, newsletter_subscriptions=0. Deviation: data dir at /var/lib/postgresql/p61v-localpg instead of docs/migration/.scratch/localpg, because the postgres user cannot traverse /home/user/... (initdb Permission denied), same as the implementer found.

checks.name: 3. npm run build against local PG16
checks.actual: exit 0. Route table: ○ /api/blog revalidate 5m; ○ /blog 1h; ● /blog/[slug] (SSG/ISR); ○ /llms.txt 1h; ○ /llms-full.txt 1h; ○ /sitemap.xml (no revalidate). prerender-manifest dynamicRoutes = ['/blog/[slug]']; initialRevalidateSeconds /api/blog=300, /blog=3600, /llms*.txt=3600, /sitemap.xml=false.

checks.name: 6a. H2 admin edit revalidates /blog/<slug>, /blog, /sitemap.xml, /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt, /api/blog
checks.expected: each route reflects the change on the next request
checks.actual: Post id 111 (d2c-trends). All 6 routes warmed to x-nextjs-cache HIT. PUT title=<marker> -> 200 (response keys unchanged, full post object). Next request: all 6 routes MISS and /blog/<slug>, /blog, /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt, /api/blog contain the marker; /sitemap.xml (no titles) lastmod for the slug changed 2026-03-06T13:14:30.336Z -> 2026-09-27T03:54:50.976Z. PUT slug rename -> 200: old slug 404, new slug 200, sitemap has new and not old, /api/blog, /llms.txt and /blog contain the new slug. Restore (slug+title) -> 200: original slug 200 with original title on all routes, renamed slug 404, marker gone from /llms-full.txt. revalidatePath works for the page, the metadata route (sitemap.xml, fully static) and the route handlers (llms*, /api/blog); no revalidateTag fallback needed. Unauth PUT 401, PUT/DELETE on missing id 404 (unchanged).

checks.name: 6b. Middleware lookup forced to time out -> /blog/<old_path> still redirects via the page (308), never a cached 404
checks.expected: 308 from the page, no 404 rendered or cached
checks.actual: Forced timeout: server restarted with DATABASE_URL host 'localhost' so node-postgres reaches PG while the Neon HTTP driver in middleware targets https://localhost/sql, where a local TCP listener on 127.0.0.1:443 accepts and never replies (3 accepts logged = middleware really hung). Synthetic bare-slug row old_path='p61v-legacy-slug' -> new_path='d2c-trends' (the format middleware.ts and H1 getRedirect(slug) look up), no post with that slug. 3 requests: 308 Location /blog/d2c-trends each, ~5.0-5.2 s (5000 ms race then fail-open), first MISS then HIT (the 308 is what gets cached, never a 404). Normal post under the same condition 200 in ~5.0 s; real missing slug 404 in ~5.0 s.

checks.name: 6c. Killed DB (pg_ctl stop) -> already cached /blog/<slug> still 200, never 404
checks.actual: After pg_ctl stop: cached /blog/top-b2b-software, /blog/winning-the-aftermarket-sales, /blog/crm-vs-sfa-sales-force-automation-guide -> 200 HIT with real titles; /blog, /llms.txt, /sitemap.xml 200 HIT. Uncached real slug (opportunity-pipeline-management-predictable-revenue) and uncached missing slug -> 500 with Cache-Control private, no-cache, no-store (never 404, not cached; repeated 500). Still 200 HIT for /blog/top-b2b-software after 5+ min with DB down. Server process stayed alive; no uncaughtException in this run's logs.

checks.name: 6d. /api/blog still returns 200 from cache with DB down
checks.actual: Immediately after stop: 200 HIT, 172 items. After waiting past the 300 s revalidate window with DB still down: 200 STALE (172 items, s-maxage=300) then 200 HIT (172 items, s-maxage=30 while Next retries regeneration). Never a 500 once cached.

checks.name: 7. Stop PG and remove the local cluster
checks.expected: PG stopped, data dir removed, test processes stopped
checks.actual: pg_ctl stop OK; /var/lib/postgresql/p61v-localpg removed (docs/migration/.scratch/localpg never created); next start, mock listener and :443 hang listener killed; port 3100 closed. git status unchanged apart from this evidence file (tsconfig.tsbuildinfo was already modified before this run).

findings.finding: All 95 blog_redirects rows store full paths (old_path '/blog/<old>'; 86 of 95 new_path also '/blog/...'), but middleware.ts, /api/blog-redirects and H1's getRedirect(slug) look up the bare slug, so no real row ever matches. Shown locally: a real-format row '/blog/p61v-fullpath-old' -> '/blog/d2c-trends' with no such post gives 404, not a redirect. If a bare-slug lookup did match a full-path new_path, the target would be '/blog//blog/<new>'. No impact today: all 95 old paths are still live posts (checked by SQL; e.g. /blog/how-to-boost-spare-parts-sales -> 200). Check 6b therefore used a synthetic bare-slug row. This is not an H-series regression. The owner or spec should decide whether to normalise it.

Cache-Control differs between states of /api/blog: prerender HIT 's-maxage=300, stale-while-revalidate=31535700', MISS after on-demand revalidation 's-maxage=300', after failed regeneration 's-maxage=30'. Similar for other ISR routes. These are header-only differences that SPEC-04 is expected to allowlist. P6.2 should confirm.

With the middleware lookup hung, every /blog/* request takes about 5 s (the H3 bound, working as spec'd). /sitemap.xml builds fully static (revalidate false). It changes only through the H2 revalidatePath, which works.

The implementer reported uncaughtException 57P01 at pg_ctl stop (lib/db.ts Pool has no 'error' listener). It did not happen in this run (fast shutdown, no idle connections terminated mid-flight), so it is neither confirmed nor ruled out.
